answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 21501 Country: India Title: Is it permissible or makruh by men to listen to audio hamd and naats sung by women? and for women to listen to naats sung by men? and what about bayaans? Question: Assalam o alekum Is it permissible or makruh by men to listen to audio hamd and naats sung by women? and for women to listen to naats sung by men? and what about bayaans? Answer ID: 21501 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 664/538/B=1431) It is not right for both to listen to the words of each other. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
